problemStatement.formal: axiom poisson_approx_birthday3 (n d : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hd : 0 < d) : |triple_prob n d - (1 - Real.exp (-(n.choose 3 : ℝ) / d ^ 2))| ≤ C * (n ^ 4 : ℝ) / d ^ 3
problemStatement.plain: Prove the total variation bound between the k=3 birthday triple-coincidence probability and its Poisson approximation using the Chen-Stein method, removing the axiom from BirthdayProblemOQ03OQ01OQ02.lean.
whyMatters: Removes axiom poisson_approx_birthday3 from existing gallery proof, reducing axiom count from 1 to 0
Demonstrates Chen-Stein method in Lean 4 — not yet in Mathlib, broadly applicable to birthday-type problems
Connects topological threshold results to probabilistic approximation theory

proven: asympThreshold d = (6 * d^2 * Real.log 2)^{1/3} (in BirthdayProblemOQ03OQ01OQ02.lean, 0 sorries)
general_threshold_exponent: For general k, threshold scales as (k! d^{k-1} ln 2)^{1/k}
